body: REQUIRED from the DM-184 review (orchestrator, this run), before retros trust imported experiment text: import never recomputes a report's content hash (pre-existing on main; importer.ts `ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET content_json`). A rewritten hypothesis, a swapped baseline measure, or a self-consistent own-revision experiment injected into an approved prose-only revision are accepted on import. Add the importer check: for any report, require `contentHash(report.content) === report.contentHash`, and refuse changed content for an existing report id (keep local). Demonstrate with exported records.
